metadata.name: SuperSwipe — Browser Entry
metadata.description: Browser entry for SuperSwipe draws on shop.travisscott.com and victorvictor.com, and the Travis Scott U.S. Shopify draws. Shopify draws: picks the colorway and size, passes Cloudflare verification on the storefront and submits the entry automatically with the profile name, email and U.S. phone; records it only when the store confirms. SuperSwipe draws: fills shipping, solves Turnstile through Key Vault and submits; optional card-on-file checkout.

inputs.label: Store / product URL
inputs.hint: shop.travisscott.com or victorvictor.com. A password-protected store fails until the draw is live.

inputs.label: Exact product title
inputs.hint: Leave blank for a single draw. For Travis Scott Shopify draws with the same title, enter the exact colorway (for example WHITE) or Title — Colorway.

inputs.label: Size selection
inputs.hint: Random chooses from available supported sizes. Size range chooses randomly within your inclusive bounds.

inputs.label: Enter all draws
inputs.hint: Travis Scott Shopify draws only: also enters the other open draws on the page in the same size (the store's own "sign up for all" option).

inputs.label: Card draws
inputs.hint: Enter draws that keep a card on file through Shopify checkout. Nothing is due today; the store charges the card later only if you are selected. Stops if checkout shows any amount due today.

inputs.label: Card source
inputs.hint: Address record card uses the card saved on each run's address (run from the Database; Scrolls 1.10.53+). Key Vault card uses one card for every run.

inputs.label: Key Vault card ID
inputs.hint: Only for Key Vault card. Leave blank for the default Key Vault card.

config.script:
return location.hostname.replace(/^www\./, '') === 'shop.travisscott.com' &&
  !!document.querySelector(".RaffleMulti__item.js-raffle[data-raffle-id] [data-raffle-data]");

Opening Shopify checkout. Busy drops queue checkouts; waiting up to 90 minutes in line.
Filling checkout contact and shipping details.
Entering the Key Vault card ($0 due today).
Entering {{vars.travisShopifyDraw.label}} in size {{vars.travisShopifyDraw.size}}. Waiting for Cloudflare verification on the storefront.
Cloudflare asked for a check; clicking the verification box.
